items.label: la fracture
items.scene: A zebra's X-ray on the light box shows a small FRACTURE ("frahk-TEWR") in its striped leg, now in a cast.

items.label: l'entorse
items.scene: A footballer's ankle twisted IN TORSION ("ahn-TORS"): a SPRAIN, wrapped in a big blue ice pack.

items.label: la bosse
items.scene: The BOSS ("BOS") in a suit has bumped his head, and a big cartoon BUMP pops up under his hand; a camel behind shows off its HUMP.

items.label: l'évacuation
items.scene: A calm EVACUATION ("ay-vah-kwah-SYOHN") drill: a mother duck leads her ducklings out under the green exit lamp.

items.label: le scanner
items.scene: A patient slides into the big doughnut SCANNER ("skah-NEHR") as the screen fills with friendly bones.

items.label: le sauvetage
items.scene: A lifeguard who SAVED ("soh-vuh") a little swimmer wheels him in, still hugging the red float: a RESCUE.

items.label: le handicap
items.scene: ANDY'S CAP ("ahn-dee-KAHP") flies off as he races his sports wheelchair up the ramp, grinning; DISABILITY never stops him.
